changes: Nearby has a History button: search saved enemies and use Previous/Next after they disappear. History keeps up to 1,000 players across sessions.
New enemies play a soft chime. Sound: on/off controls nearby alerts; fresh installs enable them and existing preferences stay saved. No raid-warning cue.
Nearby also detects readable hiding auras when a stealth cast was missed. Stealth entry and exit have distinct sounds; hidden game data remains unavailable.
Fixed false stealth-exit alerts and a history limit issue that could discard a newly encountered enemy.
Macros receives a maintenance update to shared alert settings.
notice: Restart WoW after updating Highground, Nearby or Bounties to load the new sound. The other standalone updates need only /reload. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
